Nuclear-sized mutton snapper bends rods and breaks backs as Nick joins Capt. Kevin Rowley on the Big Pine Key reefs.

title: Unfathomed
description:
S08 E01 — Abaco's Calling Pt. 1
Follow Capt. George in search of fish and adventure.

title: The Fish Guyz
description:
S06 E07 — Get Skinny
The guys head to shallow water as they sea trial a prototype flats boat; George and Lain check out the new Contender 26 Bay at the Island Boat Show in Islamorada, Fla.; chef Cat shares her recipe for lobster bites.

title: Spear Life
description:
S07 E10 — Adventure at the ZPZ Ranch
The Spear Life crew joins legendary spearfishermen Jim and Gary Zumwalt in Steinhatchee, Florida, for a day of big fish, shark encounters and valuable lessons from two icons of the sport.
